one_week_outlook.base_case: Nifty is expected to consolidate within the 22300-22700 range, with a slight upward bias. Positive FII flows and strong global cues are supportive. Key resistance at 22700 needs to be breached for further upside. Earnings season winding down with largely positive outcomes provide a floor.
one_week_outlook.bull_case: A decisive breach above 22700, driven by strong global sentiment or better-than-expected economic data, could push Nifty towards 23000. This would be fueled by continued FII buying and short covering. Probability: 30%.
one_week_outlook.bear_case: A reversal from global markets or unexpected negative domestic news could drag Nifty down to the 22300 support, potentially testing the 20-DMA at 22300. Weakness in banking stocks could accelerate this. Probability: 35%.
